_readme: The inn's one room, and the first interior in the game. It is also the first map to
use the floor / wall_rough / door / table / rug tiles, all of which the tile bank has
carried since M16 while no shipped map used any of them.
The door at [4,6] is the only way in or out, and the spawn beside it sits one tile
inside so that arriving does not immediately send the player back out - the rule every
gate pair in this game follows.
The keeper stands in FRONT of the counter rather than behind it: a table is solid, and
a keeper walled off behind one is a keeper nobody can talk to. They stand on the door's own column, so walking in and holding north finds them.
